title: 拉克丝·萌趣绘本
description: 蓝白衣装带金色饰边，金发与蓝色双眼呼应双端法杖。

art_direction.medium: cute matte-gouache picture-book mini-character, rounded painted shapes, soft colored-ink edges, visible brush pigment and warm paper
art_direction.identity: Lux is an adult blonde light mage with bright blue eyes, a composed open face, and blue-white clothing with gold trim. Preserve her slender recognizable adult identity in compact picture-book proportions and short cape while using a fully covering high-neck long-sleeved tunic, opaque tights or trousers, gloves, and boots. Her recognizable double-ended light staff rests vertically on the floor, inactive except for a restrained steady highlight.
art_direction.scene: The complete figure settles sideways on a low plain rounded ledge. Keep the existing equipment safely supported, limbs naturally separated, a slight head tilt and a softly pleased expression. Keep adult identity and age cues intact.
art_direction.palette: sky blue, ivory, pale gold, cobalt shadow; preserve canonical signature hues and skin/species colors. Supporting washes: pale sand and warm gray, enlivened by tiny coral, azure and golden-yellow accents. Light colored shadows and matte painted highlights.
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
art_direction.tone: cute and welcoming while preserving canonical age and species

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
